notes.hook: Strong opening with an active, surprising verb that immediately sets a high-stakes mystery.
notes.clarity: The script builds logically from physical structure to motion to electrical result.
notes.payoff: The confirmation that Cassini was actually struck provides a satisfying factual receipt.
notes.visuals: Excellent use of real imagery, though the orbital diagram in beat 6 is a bit busy for mobile screens.
notes.loop: The repetition of the hook phrase at the end creates a perfectly seamless loop.

frames.problem: The text on the orbital map is too small to be legible at phone size.

rounds.better_than_last: This Short uses a more concrete 'receipt' (the 200-volt electron beam hitting a specific probe) than the general facts in the Jupiter magnetic field episode.
